environment: Locally generated Next.js codegen app, production build, Chromium, synthetic in-memory data and test-only mock sessions.

capture.captions: Burned into the recording; cannot be toggled.

reproduction: Run scripts/codegen/setup-nextjs.sh, build the packages and generated Next.js app, and start a fresh in-memory server.
Use test-only mock-auth sessions as in e2e/tests/helpers/mock-auth.ts. Create three owner tickets and a different customer ticket with the same public search phrase.
Add the internal-only phrase as an agent internal note on the invoice ticket; set pending, urgent, and assignee admin-e2e.
Show the owner portal before search, search public text, reload, then search the internal-only phrase and verify zero results.
Switch to the agent session, retain status/priority/assignee URL filters, search the internal-only phrase, and open the matching agent conversation.
